timestamp_note: Transcript timestamps are approximate recognition or local transcription windows, not word-level audio timestamps or a measured pre-speech window.

sample_provenance.gaze: Experimental head-pose landmark estimates recorded; NLP/cognitive classification remains disabled.
sample_provenance.presage_biometrics: Raw blink-state observations and any enabled pulse/HRV observations. Pulse/HRV baselines use stable readings only; the paired cardio-response flag is a heuristic, not a stress diagnosis.
sample_provenance.blink_events: Stable rising transitions in SmartSpectra blink detection; rates are calculated only over approximate transcript windows and are not cognitive-state measures.

face_metric_diagnostics.note: Blinking is requested by default. Pulse and HRV are optional. Head-direction estimates are derived from SmartSpectra face landmarks only when enabled; NLP/cognitive classification remains disabled.
